title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Orbital Apartament, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, me Planimetri Perfekte!
description_sq: Ne Zonen e Bulevardit te Ri, tek rezidenca "Orbital Apartaments", Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 me Planimetri Perfekte! Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 111.32 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 96 m2, ndodhet ne katin e 4-te banim, te nje objekti ne ndertim i cili perfundon ne fillim te vitit 2026. Apartamenti organizohet ne ambientin e ndenjes me siperfaqe te bollshme se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar, nje dhome gjumi per femij, tualet i perbashket i aksesueshem ne korridor, nje depo dhe nje ballkon. Orientimi i tij eshte drejt Jug-Perendimit, cka sjell drite dhe ndricim natyral gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites. Apartamenti disponon nje garazhd ne katin -1 me cmim ekstra 15.000 euro. Apartamenti ndodhet tek nje nga godinat me te mira te kompleksit-Orbita 6, me fazade te ventiluar.
title_en: At Rezidenca Orbital Apartment, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with perfect floor plan!
description_en: In the New Boulevard area, at the "Orbital Apartments" residence, Super Apartment 2+1+2 with Perfect Layout is for sale! The apartment with a gross area of 111.32 m2 and a net area of 96 m2, is located on the 4th residential floor, of a building under construction which will be completed at the beginning of 2026. The apartment is organized in a living room with ample area together with a kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a double bedroom with a dedicated toilet, a bedroom for children, a bathroom shared access to the corridor, a storage room and a balcony. Its orientation is toward the South-West, which brings light and natural lighting during most of the day. The apartment has a garage on the -1st floor with an extra price of 15,000 euros. The apartment is located in one of the best buildings of the complex - Orbita 6, with ventilated floors.
